H01.description: Adds regression tests for chunk hashes under chunkImportMap when preload dependencies change or a shared chunk becomes pure CSS.

H02.description: Adds an SSR regression test for removing pure CSS dynamic chunks with chunkImportMap.

H03.description: Imports joinUrlSegments from shared/utils instead of ../utils; same behaviour.

H04.description: Imports decodeURIIfPossible, which the D3 fix uses.

H05.description: Drops the ../utils import of joinUrlSegments, which is now imported from shared/utils.

H06.description: CSS url() resolution calls decodeURI unguarded, so a URL with a bare '%' (e.g. url(100%.png)) throws a URIError and fails the CSS transform.

H07.description: Spreading undefined is equivalent to spreading {}; same behaviour.

H08.description: Imports the RenderedChunk type for the D1 hash-graph fix.

H09.description: Imports perEnvironmentState for the D1 hash-graph fix.

H10.description: With chunkImportMap enabled, import specifiers are stable, so preload dependencies injected in generateBundle (after hashing) are not reflected in chunk hashes; chunk content changes while the hashed file name stays the same.

H11.description: The plugin collects no per-environment chunk graph at render time, so it cannot fold preload dependency or pure-CSS changes into chunk hashes when chunkImportMap is used.

H12.description: There is no augmentChunkHash hook, so under chunkImportMap a change in preload dependencies or pure-CSS imports leaves the chunk hash unchanged even though the emitted code changes.

H13.description: When pure CSS chunks are removed from the bundle, their entries are left in the import map, which then points at files that do not exist.

H14.description: In the no-preload path (e.g. SSR) the import specifier is checked against removed pure CSS files without first being mapped through the import map, so with chunkImportMap the dynamic import of a removed CSS chunk is never replaced by Promise.resolve.

H15.description: Removes the getImportMap call here because the D2 fix moves it earlier.

H16.description: Makes deps reassignable so it can take the result of the shared collectPreloadDependencies helper.

H17.description: Replaces the inline addDeps traversal with the shared collectPreloadDependencies helper so preload deps match the hash signatures; behaviour is essentially the same (the import rewrite now happens once).

I01.description: A test snapshot updated after a later rolldown dependency bump; this is not a defect in head.

I02.description: The css post plugin decides whether to generate a sourcemap from the top-level config.build.sourcemap rather than the environment's build.sourcemap, so per-environment sourcemap settings are ignored.
